body:
Independent review of exact head `d2781cd4f376cc94acf68916fb33ea7395e0ef2e`: **changes requested before merge**. Claude retains source ownership.

1. **P2 — Preserve probe failure even when output contains the end marker.** [`hosts.py:490–497`](https://github.com/David-Martel/vigil-utils/blob/d2781cd4f376cc94acf68916fb33ea7395e0ef2e/tools/fleet_versions/hosts.py#L490-L497) treats `record["complete"]` as success and clears the `error` returned by `run_probe`. A complete compliant recording paired with `exit 255: remote session failed` produces `reachable=true`, `error=""`, `ok=1`, and `enforce_failed=false`. A remote shell/SSH failure after emitting the marker therefore disappears. Require successful process completion as well as complete output, retain the original error, and add that exact regression. Controls: the same recording with no error passes; removing the end marker correctly produces `unreachable` and fails enforcement.

2. **P2 — Reject an empty normalized host list.** [`hosts.py:473–480`](https://github.com/David-Martel/vigil-utils/blob/d2781cd4f376cc94acf68916fb33ea7395e0ef2e/tools/fleet_versions/hosts.py#L473-L480) drops every empty element without requiring a remaining host. Reproduced `check.py --hosts ', ,' --enforce`: exit **0**, zero hosts, zero findings, `no findings`. An empty expanded fleet variable can therefore pass the gate without measuring anything. Return a clear usage error before constructing the report; test empty/whitespace/comma-only input and retain a valid-host positive control.

3. **P2 — Bind colcon metadata to the PATH candidate being reported.** [`hosts.py:94–105`](https://github.com/David-Martel/vigil-utils/blob/d2781cd4f376cc94acf68916fb33ea7395e0ef2e/tools/fleet_versions/hosts.py#L94-L105) always queries `/usr/bin/python3` but attributes that metadata to the first `colcon` executable on PATH. The generated block then stops after that candidate ([lines 230–234](https://github.com/David-Martel/vigil-utils/blob/d2781cd4f376cc94acf68916fb33ea7395e0ef2e/tools/fleet_versions/hosts.py#L230-L234)). An older venv/tool-installed colcon winning PATH can thus be labeled with the newer system distribution and its other candidates omitted. Either safely identify/query each candidate's interpreter or explicitly report a separate system-distribution observation without claiming PATH-winner identity. Add a fixture with differing system/venv versions and a system-colcon positive control. This finding is source analysis of the exact generated command, not a live fleet measurement.

Verification: small exact-head archive, isolated read-only/network-disabled container `sha256:fb96e945cf5f35da4975b1feb23ce8c86fbe1afce54bd250ba97f75602c78d43`; two executable counterexamples and passing/failing controls. No SSH, live host census, source edits, or full QA rerun. Existing prerelease comparison behavior is a separate known carryover, not attributed to this patch. Local evidence: `/home/damartel/dev/evidence/utils-pr334-review-20261002/`.
